environment.detail: Exact instruction/source pins, clean detached worktree, zero open PRs at start, config/input/init/partition/parameter match, RTX 4090/resources above floors, deterministic/TF32 off; no source edits or installs.

handover.detail: Flat sanitized package with diagnostic report, exact reproduction, corrected routing, localization analysis, preserved driver failures and execution log; validator result in PR body.

localization.detail: Forward-only same-input FP32/FP64 GDN comparison, per-pass propagation and BF16 boundary statistics, router top2 margins at first mismatch, FP32 full forward and teacher-forced scan-route diagnostic; no raw tensors/IDs/logits published.

reproduction.detail: T0025 scan identity and losses exact; chunk64 published loss delta 0.0; per-key routing mismatch counts exact; tensor metrics exact; corrected token-weighted routing 34/4096 overall (pass 1 5/2048, pass 2 29/2048).

limitations: One synthetic T512 forward invocation and one seed; no training, backward, optimizer update, checkpoint or actual data.
No learning, quality, convergence, production, timing, throughput or energy claim.
Same-input FP32 is a local control; propagated BF16 comparisons include recurrence, cast and routing effects.
BF16 cast/route timing is observational; route flips are not established as the first cause.
Teacher-forced routes are a diagnostic intervention, not production routing and not an equivalence claim.
